headers.//: Five minutes at the edge, not an hour, and a ten-minute stale window rather than a day. This file's behaviour changes, not just its styling: when remote configuration shipped, sites still holding the previous bundle had no way to ask for their settings at all, so a colour changed in the dashboard appeared to do nothing until the cache aged out. Propagation now costs minutes. It is a 10 kB static file behind a CDN, so the extra revalidations are not worth optimising against.
